design_philosophy: Utilitarian, tactical, and highly functional. Built for field merchandisers working in varied lighting conditions (from dark aisles to bright sun). Eschews soft SaaS gradients for neo-brutalist sharp edges, 2px structural borders, and stark, unapologetic contrast.

surfaces_and_shadows.button_primary: bg-blue-600 text-white border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
surfaces_and_shadows.button_secondary: bg-yellow-400 text-black border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
surfaces_and_shadows.input: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 p-4 font-medium
surfaces_and_shadows.badge: px-2 py-1 border-2 border-black text-xs font-bold uppercase

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layout_and_spacing.grid_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

camera_watermark.style: absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-black/80 text-white p-3 border-2 border-white backdrop-blur-none

gps_status_indicator.verified: w-4 h-4 rounded-none bg-green-500 border-2 border-black
gps_status_indicator.pending: w-4 h-4 rounded-none bg-yellow-400 border-2 border-black
gps_status_indicator.failed: w-4 h-4 rounded-none bg-red-500 border-2 border-black animate-pulse

offline_banner.style: bg-yellow-400 text-black font-bold uppercase text-xs p-2 text-center border-b-2 border-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2

login_background.description: Minimalist Swiss design topographic map pattern. Use as a background for the login screen.

sync_graphic.description: Abstract high-contrast utilitarian geometric shapes for sync/offline empty states.

animations.list_stagger: framer-motion with staggerChildren: 0.1 for customer lists

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the light theme, stark contrast neo-brutalist style.
Do NOT use transparent gradients or rounded-xl borders. Everything must feel like a hard, physical 'tactical' UI.
Borders are solid 2px black. Shadows are solid black dropshadows with no blur (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]).
Use Phosphor icons for clear, dense UI navigation.
The camera view watermark should be displayed in monospace text at the bottom overlay over the image.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
For the map, if using a web map library, use a high-contrast black-and-white map style.
